newsitem.title: USA: American Dental licenses laser patents.
newsitem.headline: American Dental licenses laser patents.

text.p: American Dental Technologies Inc said Friday it signed a letter of intent to license two patents on a non-exclusive basis to Continuum Electro-Optics Inc.
American Dental said it agreed to give a non-exclusive license for two of its patents covering the use of Erbium Yag lasers in dental procedures on hard tissue or teeth.
Continuum, which makes medical and dental lasers, is a subsidiary of Hoya Corp USA, which is owned by Hoya Ltd of Japan.

"We are pleased that Hoya Ltd, a $2.0 billion company, has recognized ADT's basic patent position in the use of Erbium Yag lasers for hard tissue in dental procedures and look forward to working with them in the future," Ben Gallant, president of American Dental, said in a statement.

American Dental said it also entered a distribution agreement under which it would distribute a Continuum-produced Erbium Yag laser for use in hard tissue dental applications such as cavity preparations.
American Dental said the hard tissue laser will complement its line of dental lasers for soft tissue or gum procedures to treat periodontal disease.
